noveltyJustification: Confirms the corpus baseline and turns the style contract into a first ranked set of reusable conversion, keep-single, and scope-boundary decisions.

label: The verified corpus baseline is 56 validator-scanned playbook packages with four JSON conversation scenarios: one in sk-create-manual-testing-playbook and three in system-spec-kit.

The style decision is ordered: judgment stays single at Q1; multi-exchange, answer-dependent behavior, restart or compaction is conversation at Q2; cross-runtime or release-regression behavior is conversation at Q3 only when shell checks decide every turn; otherwise Q4 stays single.

Keep the three system-spec-kit conversation scenarios as working Q2 prototypes: live decision capture already scripts question answers, compaction and restart, while kill-switch and sibling re-proof script question-tool answers and answer-dependent state.

Prioritize JSON conversion for system-spec-kit session-relaunch-claude and session-relaunch-pi-opencode at Q2; session-relaunch-command-runtimes is Q2 and Q3 but should split supported Codex/Devin runs from Cursor/Hermes until the runner supports those runtimes.

Keep cli-devin DV-001 and system-spec-kit 449 compact/names-only CLI discovery at Q4: each checks one request or command result; the word compact in the latter is output compaction, not session compaction.

Workflow scope conflict recorded: YAML pre-init and post-synthesis steps write or validate the parent spec and resource map; the dispatch bounds writes to this lineage and explicitly forbids those operations, so those steps are omitted while lineage-local initialization and synthesis proceed.
